Ongoing: each mission takes 30–90 min; each repeatable task 10–60 min

A set of missions and repeatable tasks in Rathleton and Oramond (also called Rathleton Tasks or Glooth Factory Quest). You help scientists, guards and citizens fight bandits, minotaurs, mutated glooth and other problems of the city. Each mission or task gives voting rights in the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate|Rathleton Magistrate}, which you use to rank up in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest}.
The citizens of the newly discovered city of Rathleton need help to defend their civilisation from various threats.
Terrence, Workshop Quarter of Rathleton (tasks without rank)
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 200**: almost all zones have strong creatures.

The missions and tasks in the {wiki:Underground Glooth Factory|Underground Glooth Factory} (Glooth Bandits, Four Demanding Statues, Mutated Glooth Plague, the final part of Gloud Ship, Nature's Balance, Glooth Capsules, Tending Gloothworms and Gloud Ship Tasks) require the **Citizen** rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest} (300 votes in total).
Some of {npc:Terrence}'s kill tasks require a rank: The Name of the Beast and The Minor Taurs (Commoner), Rust in Pieces (Inhabitant), The Major Taurs (Citizen).
Four Demanding Statues mission (buy from Henricus, in Thais)
The Glooth Bandits mission (and Glooth Capsules task)
recommended for the Probing task (avoids getting Drunk from the fungi)
or Fire Bomb Rune / Fire Field Rune, to block creatures in the new sewers

Voting rights at the Rathleton Magistrate (used in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest}): Glooth Bandits 2, Four Demanding Statues 4, Mutated Glooth Plague 5, The Gloud Ship 3; tasks usually 1 vote each
you can build one and keep it to purify Tainted Glooth Capsules
Chance to get a {item:Necrometer} from {npc:Jondrin} ({wiki:Dark Trails Quest|Dark Trails Quest}) after doing the Probing task
Each mission or task gives voting rights in the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate|Rathleton Magistrate}: 50 for Commoner, 150 for Inhabitant, 300 for Citizen and 500 for Squire.
Necrometer from the Dark Trails Quest
After doing the **Probing** task from {npc:Doubleday}, {npc:Jondrin} will give you the {item:Necrometer}.
The {wiki:Dark Trails Quest|Dark Trails Quest} also asks for other tasks from this quest (for example The Ancient Sewers).
The tasks were designed to be done while you hunt normally. **The Powder of the Stars** and **To Take Roots** work well during a hunt.

Faster tasks for earning votes: **Communication Breakdown**, **Combinatorics** (needs good coordination), **The Ancient Sewers** and **Cooking Gloo** (needs the Citizen rank and the The Gloud Ship mission).
Kill tasks with almost no extra effort: **Taking the Rot Out**, **The Minor Taurs**, **The Name of the Beast** and **Nature's Balance**.
**Tending Gloothworms** has a daily limit (3 tasks per day) and is not good for farming votes. **Glooth Capsules** lets you "buy" votes if you get the capsules on the Market.
According to the wiki, **Probing**, **Rathleton Turnip Party**, **Sabotage** and **Dr. Merlay's Misery** are not worth it for the points alone (a lot of work for 1 vote).
Do the surface tasks first to reach the Citizen rank; only then do you get access to the Underground Glooth Factory and its missions.
Each mission can be done once; many unlock a repeatable task. Tasks can be repeated as many times as you like (some have a daily limit).

The usual way to get to Oramond is by boat from **Thais** (with the Citizen rank in the Rathleton Quest there are more connections). At the Thais port talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You disembark on a raft **west** of Oramond, next to {npc:Captain Gulliver}. Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island, where there are minotaurs. Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat: the portal on that boat takes you to the other side of the water, closer to the city. From there head **north** to the main gate and then **west** to the ramp up to the upper city (or climb the stairs to the dock, go down the ramp on the other side and head **north** to the same ramp).
Mound where the Slime Slide drops you off
Path from the boat to Rathleton
The path between the boat and the city passes through minotaurs: the wiki advises at least level ~100 and, if possible, going in a group.
With the Citizen rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest}, the Slime Slide next to the boat takes you straight to Rathleton, without going past the minotaurs.

To return to the mainland, do the reverse route to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the Citizen rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide also takes you back to the boat). Say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp) to return to Thais. With the Citizen rank he also takes you to **Edron**, **Venore**, **Port Hope** and **Krailos**; **Issavi** is always available.
Use this table to pick the tasks that suit you. All of them give votes (or favours) that end up with the Rathleton Magistrate. The following sections explain each one step by step.
Kill {creature:Glooth Golem}, {creature:Devourer} and {creature:Glooth Anemone} in the right order
Throw {item:Supply Crate|Supply Crates} into the water
Deliver letters and create a pill
Tend the gloothworm farm (up to 3 per day)
Needs the Citizen rank (it is in the Underground Glooth Factory). Reward: 2 votes.

In Rathleton, go to {npc:Terrence}'s building, east of the stairs to Upper Rathleton, and enter the {wiki:Slime Slide|Slime Slide}. It takes you to the Underground Glooth Factory (floor -5). To leave, use the Slime Slide next to where you appeared: you return to Rathleton's Workshop Quarter.
Slime Slide to the Underground Glooth Factory
The Slime Slide only works if you already have the **Citizen** rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest} (300 votes).
Talk to {npc:Elbert}: {key:hi}, {key:trouble} (or {key:mission}), {key:yes}. He asks you to recover 10 {item:Glooth Capsule|Glooth Capsules} stolen by the bandits.
Kill {creature:Glooth Bandit|Glooth Bandits} and {creature:Glooth Brigand|Glooth Brigands} until you have 10 {item:Glooth Capsule|Glooth Capsules}, or buy them on the Market or from a friend.
Elbert **does not accept** {item:Tainted Glooth Capsule|Tainted Glooth Capsules}. He only accepts them after you purify them with a {item:Filled Glooth Converter} (section 4).
Go back to {npc:Elbert} with the 10 capsules and say {key:hi}, {key:yes}. The mission is completed and right after he offers you the Four Demanding Statues mission (section 3).
Extra capsules give votes (Glooth Capsules task, section 10), but only after you finish the Four Demanding Statues mission.
Find out who is behind the bandits. Needs the Citizen rank. Reward: 4 votes.
Right after handing in the capsules, answer {key:yes} to {npc:Elbert} (or talk to him and ask for {key:mission}). He tells you the bandits have a secret hideout in the tunnels to the southwest.

Go to **Thais** and buy a {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water flask} from {npc:Henricus}. You will use it on the statue in the north. To get there, take {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}); to come back, talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the Thais port ({key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}) and repeat the route from section 1 to Rathleton.
Pick up the {item:Lyre} at this spot in the Underground Glooth Factory, or buy one from {npc:Fayla} in Rathleton.
Look for a {item:Heap of Rubbish} at one of these spots and use it to get a {item:Dead Rat (Oramond)|Dead Rat}.
Getting a Dead Rat from a Heap of Rubbish

In the mushroom area to the east, there are {item:Dinky Moss Floret|Dinky Moss Florets} on the mountain walls. Use them to collect **at least 3** {item:Dinky Moss Floret|Dinky Moss Florets}. The map shows all the locations.
Find at least 3 Dinky Moss Florets

Use one {item:Dinky Moss Floret} on another {item:Dinky Moss Floret} to create an {item:Interwoven Moss Floret}. Then use the third {item:Dinky Moss Floret} on the {item:Interwoven Moss Floret} to get the {item:Dinky Moss Floret Garland}.

The hideout entrance is **southwest** of the Slime Slide where you entered the Underground Glooth Factory. Go up through the hole, follow the short path **south** and go down another hole: you arrive in a big, strange room. Go further down in that room until you see four statues around a large black stone figure.
Bring a {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel} for the holes.

The {item:Dead Explorer} is at this spot in the room. His paper talks of an ancient temple with four statues, each with a wish inscribed, and says the erased inscription must be *"Adorn me."* That is: you have to **bless**, **adorn**, **feed** and **entertain** the four statues.
Stand in front of the {item:Angel Statue} (to the **north**) and use the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water} on the statue.
Blessing the statue with Holy Water
Stand in front of the {item:Sacred Statue} (to the **east**). **First use the statue** to put out the flame. Only then use the {item:Dinky Moss Floret Garland} on the statue.
If you do not put out the flame first, the {item:Dinky Moss Floret Garland} is destroyed and you have to make another.
Adorning the statue with the Dinky Moss Floret Garland
Stand in front of the {item:Cobra Statue} (to the **south**) and use the {item:Dead Rat (Oramond)|Dead Rat} on the statue.
Feeding the statue with the special Dead Rat
Stand in front of the {item:Statue (King)|King Statue} (to the **west**) and play the {item:Lyre} (use it) in front of it.
Entertaining the statue by playing the Lyre

With the four statues animated, enter the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the centre. You are teleported to a room on the floor above, full of {creature:Glooth Bandit|Glooth Bandits} and {creature:Glooth Brigand|Glooth Brigands}.
Go to the **easternmost** part of the cave and kill the {creature:Warlock}. Then walk around the room until you receive this message:
The {creature:Warlock} is a strong mage and is surrounded by bandits. Do not go in with low health.
Reading the letter on the bookcase

In the **northeast** corner of the room, open the {item:Bookcase|bookcase} to get a parchment: a letter from *Uquora the High-Handed*, of the **Circle of the Black Sphinx**, proving that the warlock hired the bandits.
Search the bookcase for the warlock's letter

Go back to the Underground Glooth Factory on foot through the bandits' cave (the wiki does not describe any shortcut out of this room) and head to {npc:Elbert}, to the south of the factory. To leave the factory, use the Slime Slide next to where you appeared when you entered.
On the way back you keep running into {creature:Glooth Bandit|Glooth Bandits} and {creature:Glooth Brigand|Glooth Brigands}.
Go back to {npc:Elbert} and say {key:hi}. The mission ends as soon as you greet him.
Build a glooth converter to clean up the mutated (purple) glooth. Needs the Citizen rank. Reward: 5 votes.
Talk to {npc:Georgia Rainbird} in her laboratory: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:no}. She gives you a {item:Strange Device} (the unfinished converter) and tells you which parts are missing.
Gather 5 {item:Bronze Gear Wheel|Bronze Gear Wheels}. They drop from {creature:Glooth Golem|Glooth Golems}, {creature:Metal Gargoyle|Metal Gargoyles} and {creature:Rustheap Golem|Rustheap Golems}.
Use a {item:Copper Valve} (object on the wall) to dismantle it and get the {item:Copper Valve (Item)|Copper Valve}.
Open the box at this spot to get the {item:Calibrated Indicator Gauge}. You can take a new one every 2 minutes.
Talk to {npc:Elbert} and say {key:hi}, {key:glass tube}. He gives you the {item:Glass Tube}.

Use, one by one, the {item:Bronze Gear Wheel|Bronze Gear Wheels}, the {item:Copper Valve (Item)|Copper Valve}, the {item:Calibrated Indicator Gauge} and the {item:Glass Tube} on the {item:Strange Device}. In the end you have a {item:Glooth Converter}.
Assemble the glass tube: now it works
Go back to {npc:Georgia Rainbird}. She explains that she needs an antidote to eliminate the effect of the mutated glooth.

Look for a {item:Crimson Crest Mushroom (Immobile)|Crimson Crest Mushroom} near the {item:Slime (Purple)|Purple Slime} puddles (there are several in the Underground Glooth Factory) and use it to get a {item:Crimson Crest Mushroom}. Once picked, it takes **5 minutes** to grow back.
Using a Crimson Crest Mushroom to pick it
Go back to {npc:Georgia Rainbird}'s laboratory and use the {item:Crimson Crest Mushroom} on the {item:Alchemical Apparatus}. You get a {item:Vial of Mushroom Distillate}.
Create a Vial of Mushroom Distillate
Use the {item:Vial of Mushroom Distillate} on the {item:Glooth Converter}. You now have a {item:Filled Glooth Converter}.

Use the {item:Filled Glooth Converter} on **8** {item:Slime (Purple)|Purple Slime} puddles, as if it were a fishing rod. Aim at the **centre** of the puddle so the floor edges do not block it. On the eighth, the converter breaks and gives you back the {item:Strange Device}, 5 {item:Bronze Gear Wheel|Bronze Gear Wheels}, the {item:Copper Valve (Item)|Copper Valve}, the {item:Calibrated Indicator Gauge} and the {item:Glass Tube}.
Using the Glooth Converter to convert 8 mutated glooth puddles

With those parts you can assemble another converter straight away and fill it with another {item:Vial of Mushroom Distillate}. A stored {item:Filled Glooth Converter} can be used to purify {item:Tainted Glooth Capsule|Tainted Glooth Capsules} (and in that case it does not break).
Talk to {npc:Georgia Rainbird} to finish the mission.

Help the scientist {npc:Zeronex} build a glooth gas balloon ("gloud"). You need 20 {item:Piece of Crocodile Leather|Pieces of Crocodile Leather} and 10 {item:Shrimp}. The final part is in the Underground Glooth Factory (Citizen rank). Reward: 3 votes and 3 new tasks.
Go to the Rathleton port and walk around the city wall until you find a {item:Ladder}. Climb the ladder to the top and walk a little to the **north**.
Talk to {npc:Zeronex}: {key:hi}, {key:incident}, {key:yes}. He needs a strong, airtight cloth and sends you to talk to {npc:Nicholas} (Nicholas Cavendish), without mentioning his name.

{npc:Nicholas} is in Upper Rathleton, above the post office. Climb the {item:Ladder (Oramond)|ladder} on the **south** side of the building. Say {key:hi}, {key:very strong cloth}: he asks for 20 {item:Piece of Crocodile Leather|Pieces of Crocodile Leather}.
With the 20 leather pieces, say {key:very strong cloth} again. {npc:Nicholas} keeps the leather, tells you the secret (steel spider silk) and gives you a {item:Milking Fork}.

Look for {item:Spider (Steel)|Steel Spiders} (small spiders that walk on the floor; not the webs) and use the {item:Milking Fork} on them until you have **15** {item:Steel Spider Silk}. The {wiki:Glooth Factory|Glooth Factory} has more spiders, but you also find them in the Rathleton sewers and elsewhere.
Using the Milking Fork on the spider to get Steel Spider Silk (15x)
Some similar-looking "spiders" are {item:Something Crawling} and give no silk.
Go to the west side of the Workshop Quarter and use the {item:Steel Spider Silk} on the {item:Yarn-Winding Winch} of the {item:Yarn-Winding Machine}. You get a {item:Spool of Steel Silk Yarn}.
Use the Steel Spider Silk on the Yarn-Winding Winch
Go to the room **below** {npc:Zeronex} and use the {item:Spool of Steel Silk Yarn} on the {item:Weaving Loom}. You get a {item:Strong Cloth}.
Use the Spool of Steel Silk Yarn on the Weaving Loom
Climb the ladder and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} to {npc:Zeronex}. He keeps the {item:Strong Cloth} and tells you to talk to the fisherman {npc:Yeo} about a very strong glue.
Go to the Rathleton port and talk to {npc:Yeo}: {key:hi}, {key:strong glue}, {key:gloo}. He wants 10 {item:Shrimp}.
With 10 {item:Shrimp}, say {key:hi}, {key:gloo}, {key:yes} to {npc:Yeo}. You receive a {item:Bottle of Gloo}.

Go to the pharmacy in the west part of the Rathleton Workshop Quarter, west of the stairs. On the **2nd floor** open the {item:Bookcase (Rathleton)|bookcase} to get {item:Glooth Farina}. Go up one more floor and open the bookcases to the **north** to get {item:Pink Gloud Essence} and {item:Glooth Vinegar}.
You may not need all of them, or you may need more than one. After you use an ingredient, you can open the same bookcase to take another.
Putting the gloo in the cauldron
There are {item:Glooth Cauldron|Glooth Cauldrons} just **east** of the pharmacy (and also on the upper floor). Use the {item:Bottle of Gloo} on a cauldron.

Now **use the cauldron** repeatedly. Whenever one of these messages appears, do what the table says before you carry on using the cauldron. You are done when you receive *"You have retrieved some airtight gloo."* and have the {item:Bottle of Airtight Gloo}.
Use {item:Pink Gloud Essence} on the cauldron
(when shaking) Nothing happens. Maybe if you shook it a little more?
(when shaking) The mix decomposes. Try to cook up some gloo at the cauldrons again.
You lose the plasma (it becomes {item:Rubbish}); keep using the cauldron
Done: you have the {item:Bottle of Airtight Gloo}
Getting the Bottle of Airtight Gloo by using the cauldron and following the messages
If you need more ingredients, go back to the pharmacy: the bookcases give you another one after you use the previous one.
Go back to {npc:Zeronex} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} (or {key:airtight gloo}). He gives you an {item:Airtight Cloth} to keep and a {item:Gas Bag} for the last stage.
Ask {npc:Zeronex} for more {item:Airtight Cloth}. Give one to each of these Rathleton NPCs: {npc:Yeo}, {npc:Nicholas}, {npc:Barazbaz}, {npc:Alaistar}, {npc:Fayla} and {npc:Christine} (6 in total).

Enter the Slime Slide in {npc:Terrence}'s building (east of the stairs to Upper Rathleton) to get to the Underground Glooth Factory. Go to the **west-southwest** end of the cave: Zeronex's laboratory is there.
You need the Citizen rank to enter the Underground Glooth Factory.

Use the three {item:Glooth Data Machine|Glooth Data Machines} against the walls (north, west and northwest of the laboratory). Use each one from the **east** side, **repeatedly**, until you get the full calibration message for that machine (the order may vary).
Green = use these machines; yellow = use the Gas Bag on this machine
With the three calibrated, use the {item:Gas Bag} on the {item:Glooth Data Machine} in the **centre** of the laboratory. You get a {item:Full Gas Bag}.
Using the Gas Bag on the Glooth Data Machine to get a Full Gas Bag
Leave via the Slime Slide near where you appeared when you entered and go back to {npc:Zeronex}: {key:hi}, {key:yes} (or {key:mission}).
3 votes and access to Zeronex's 3 tasks (section 10).
{npc:Doubleday} is in the Workshop Quarter. His tasks give **favours**, which you then exchange for votes with {key:exchange}.

Optional: talk to {npc:Doubleday} ({key:hi}, {key:combinatorics}, {key:yes}). It is not mandatory: the task activates by itself when you kill the right creatures in the {wiki:Rathleton New Sewers|Rathleton New Sewers}.

In the Rathleton New Sewers, kill {creature:Glooth Golem|Glooth Golems}, {creature:Devourer|Devourers} and {creature:Glooth Anemone|Glooth Anemones} **in the order** shown in your Quest Log or Server Log. After 9 right creatures in a row you start a **Consecutive Chain**; every 3 additional right creatures give 1 more vote.
Killing the wrong creature **resets your chains to zero**. If you are not going for a record, report often so you do not lose progress.
The spawns in the New Sewers are dynamic, so it is hard to predict where each creature appears. 10 chains in a row in a single task earn the **Combo Master** achievement.
Go back to {npc:Doubleday} and say {key:hi}, {key:combinatorics}, {key:yes} to register the chains.
Registered Consecutive Chains are then exchanged for votes with Doubleday; 10 chains in a row = **Combo Master** achievement.
Talk to {npc:Doubleday}: {key:hi}, {key:communications}, {key:yes}. He marks a {item:Sewer Grate} on your map.
Communication Breakdown: going down to the sewers
Go **southwest** of Doubleday's building, under the docks, and enter the {item:Sewer Grate}. You go down 2 floors.

There are {creature:Glooth Anemone|Glooth Anemones}, {creature:Glooth Golem|Glooth Golems} and {creature:Devourer|Devourers} here. Bring {item:Fire Wall Rune|Fire Wall}, {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb} or {item:Fire Field Rune|Fire Field Runes} to block them.
To return to the surface, use the base of the {item:Rungs In The Wall|rungs in the wall} like a normal ladder.
Find one of the 3 {item:Generator (Big)|Massive Generators} on this floor: one to the **east** (the closest) and two to the **north**.

Use one of the two {item:Slimy Valve|Slimy Valves} **south** of the generator **3 times**. Each time coloured steam comes out and an orange text appears with the colour (e.g. *"Yellow steam emerges..."*). **Write down the 3 colours in order.**

Pull the levers in the same order as the colours. Example: violet, green, red = {item:Violet Lever}, then {item:Green Lever}, then {item:Red Lever}. The same colour can repeat in a row; the levers take **5 seconds** to become usable again.
If the colour repeats, wait the 5 seconds before pulling the same lever again.
After the 3 right levers a {item:Strangely Coloured Glooth} appears on the floor, **north** of the levers. Use it to get a {item:Vial of Coloured Glooth}.
Take the vial to {npc:Doubleday} and say {key:hi}, {key:communications}, {key:yes}.
If you fiddle with the {item:Vial of Coloured Glooth} it breaks. Even so, Doubleday accepts the task as complete.
Talk to {npc:Doubleday}: {key:hi}, {key:probe}, {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Mono Detector} and a {item:Strange Probing Device}.

Do not fiddle with the {item:Strange Probing Device}: moving it inside a container or putting it down in the wrong place makes it disappear (you can move the container it is in). To ask for another, say {key:detector} to Doubleday, but only **30 minutes** after you received the first one (or right after handing in a printout).

Enter the {wiki:Rathleton New Sewers|Rathleton New Sewers} through the same {item:Sewer Grate} as Communication Breakdown (under the docks, south of the Workshop Quarter) and go down inside the sewers to the area of the abnormal spots, on floor -4. There, use the {item:Mono Detector} to find an **abnormal spot**. To leave, go back the same way to the grate arrival point and climb the {item:Rungs In The Wall|rungs in the wall} (use them like a ladder).

Dangerous area: {creature:Glooth Anemone|Glooth Anemones}, {creature:Glooth Golem|Glooth Golems}, {creature:Devourer|Devourers}, {creature:Rustheap Golem|Rustheap Golems}, {creature:Humongous Fungus|Humongous Fungi} and {creature:Hideous Fungus|Hideous Fungi}. Use a {item:Dwarven Ring} to avoid getting Drunk from the fungi.
Probing: place and activate the probe

Drag the {item:Strange Probing Device} from your backpack to the floor, on top of the abnormal spot. It turns into an {item:Active Probing Device}. **Use it straight away** while it is on the floor: you receive a {item:Crude Primitive Printout} in your backpack.
Take the printout to {npc:Doubleday} and say {key:hi}, {key:probe}. He keeps the printout and the {item:Mono Detector} (if you have it).
1 favour. After completing this task you can ask {npc:Jondrin} for a {item:Necrometer} in the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest|Dark Trails Quest}.
If you have several {item:Strange Probing Device|Strange Probing Devices}, you can use them all at once for several favours; handing in the printouts is not mandatory.
Say {key:hi}, {key:exchange} to {npc:Doubleday}, then type the **number** of votes you want and confirm with {key:yes}. You cannot ask for more votes than the favours you have.
7. Terrence's tasks: Turnip Party and Sabotage
{npc:Terrence} is the Workshop Quarter guard. These two tasks take place in the {wiki:Oramond Minotaur Camp|Oramond Minotaur Camp}, east of the city.
Talk to {npc:Terrence}: {key:hi}, {key:supplies}, {key:yes}. It is not mandatory: the task starts by itself when you use the first {item:Supply Crate (Immobile)|Supply Crate}.
Turnip Party: getting to the camp

Cross the Rathleton Workshops ({creature:Metal Gargoyle|Metal Gargoyles} and {creature:Rustheap Golem|Rustheap Golems}) and keep going **east** to the ramp of the Oramond Minotaur Camp. In the first part of the camp there are {creature:Mooh'Tah Warrior|Mooh'Tah Warriors}, {creature:Worm Priestess|Worm Priestesses} and {creature:Minotaur Hunter|Minotaur Hunters}. Inside the camp, go to the next ramp.

The first ramp leads to a relatively safe area with a Slime Slide (it takes you to the Rathleton depot if your world voted for that shortcut; otherwise it is just 1 sqm of Protection Zone). Go up the second ramp to reach the mountain.

On the mountain there are {creature:Moohtant|Moohtants}, {creature:Execowtioner|Execowtioners}, {creature:Minotaur Amazon|Minotaur Amazons}, {creature:Mooh'Tah Warrior|Mooh'Tah Warriors}, {creature:Worm Priestess|Worm Priestesses} and {creature:Minotaur Hunter|Minotaur Hunters}.
Turnip Party: picking up a crate
Use a {item:Supply Crate (Immobile)|Supply Crate} on the mountain to get a {item:Supply Crate}.
Supply Crate / way down to the water
**Do not touch** the {item:Supply Crate} in your inventory or drop it: the moohtants take it straight away and you lose the crate.
Turnip Party: throwing the crate in the water

Go down the **southeast** ramp of the mountain to a safe area with {item:Shallow Water} and use the {item:Supply Crate} on the water (any Shallow Water will do). A {item:Floating Crate of Turnips} appears.
Throwing a Supply Crate into the water
Repeat: one crate at a time, until you have thrown **10** crates into the water. After the tenth you cannot pick up any more until you report.

Go back **west** the same way: come down the mountain by the ramps, cross the camp and pass the entrance mound to the Rathleton Workshops and {npc:Terrence}. If your world voted for that shortcut in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest}, the {item:Slime Slide} in the safe area after the first ramp takes you straight to the Rathleton depot (otherwise it is just 1 sqm of Protection Zone).
Slime Slide (shortcut to Rathleton, if voted)

Optional: ask {npc:Terrence} for the task (it starts by itself when you use the cowcoa nozzle). Take the same route through the camp: entrance ramp, east ramp, and the south ramp. To the **south** of that second ramp there is a {item:Mill|mill} with a {item:Nozzle for Cowcoa} just south of it. Use it to get a {item:Cup of Cowcoa}.
The {item:Cup of Cowcoa} only lasts **3 minutes**.
You only receive another cup if you are not carrying one. Put the first one on the floor, ask for another, and then pick them up: that way you can destroy several racks at once.

Go back to the surface and look for the {item:Mootant Armor Rack|Mootant Armor Racks} (4 on the lower floor; 3 more going up the stairs to the south). Use the {item:Cup of Cowcoa} on a rack: it turns into a {item:Mootant Armor Rack (Destroyed)}.
If the cup expires before you reach the rack, you receive *"The acrid cowcoa has actually corroded its way out of the vessel."* and have to go and get another.
Sabotage: racks on the upper floor
The other 3 racks are on the upper floor (go up the stairs to the south).
Repeat until you have destroyed **10** racks. Leave the camp as in the Turnip Party (same way west, or the Slime Slide if your world voted for it) and say {key:hi}, {key:sabotage} to {npc:Terrence}.
The message above appears if you try to destroy an 11th rack before reporting.
Each kill task asks for exactly 100 creatures (if you kill more, they count as 100) and gives 1 vote. You can restart each one whenever you like.
Talk to {npc:Terrence} and say {key:hi}, {key:killing} and the word of the task you want. The task becomes active in the Quest Log.
Oramond Marshes and Oramond Minotaur Camp
Kill the 100 creatures anywhere in Oramond. The best places are in the table above.
Go back to {npc:Terrence} and say the **same words** you used to ask for the task (e.g. {key:hi}, {key:killing}, {key:rot}).

Talk to one of the Glooth brothers: {npc:Elliott} or {npc:Jacob}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Both are in the {wiki:Rathleton Ancient Sewers|Rathleton Ancient Sewers}, under Lower Rathleton. To get to {npc:Elliott}: go **north** of {npc:Roswitha}, pass {npc:Fillias} and go down via the sewer entrance (use the sewer cover if needed); then walk **east** and **north**. To leave, go back the same way to that entrance.

Repair 20 {item:Smoking Generator|Smoking Generators} or {item:Leaky Tube|Leaky Tubes}: look for the ones giving off **dark smoke** and use them. There is a group of 4 near {npc:Elliott}. Each one breaks again after **2 minutes**.
If you make more than 20 repairs before reporting, the extra ones count for next time.
Go back to {npc:Elliott} or {npc:Jacob} and report.
The Powder of the Stars: accept
Go to {npc:Barnabas Dee}, **2 floors above** {npc:Flint}'s armour shop, and ask for a {key:mission}. He wants 15 {item:Blue Pollen|blue pollens}.
The Powder of the Stars: collecting pollen

Go to the {wiki:Oramond Hydra/Bog Raider Cave|Oramond Hydra/Bog Raider Cave}, **northwest** of Rathleton, and go down through the entrance hole. Inside, use the {item:Peppermoon Bells} until you have 15 pollens. The plants regrow every **2 minutes**. To leave, go back to where you came down and return to Rathleton the same way.
Oramond Hydra/Bog Raider Cave entrance hole
Collecting pollen from the Peppermoon Bells

Sometimes you get Drunk for **10 seconds** ("Achoo!" message). Be careful if there are creatures nearby. The trip there and back over the surface can also be dangerous because of the frequent Quara raids.
Extra pollen is saved for the next delivery. You have to collect it yourself: a friend cannot give you pollen.
The Powder of the Stars: deliver
Go back to {npc:Barnabas Dee} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.

Optional: ask {npc:Chavis} for the task at the *Commensal House for the Destitute and Homeless*; it also starts by itself when you use a {item:Juicy Root}. You find roots in the Oramond Marshes, the Oramond Minotaur Camp and the Western Plains. Use each {item:Juicy Root}: it can go well or badly, but either way it becomes a {item:Harvested Root} and takes **5 minutes** to grow again.
Success: You successfully harvest some juicy roots.
Failure: the harvest destroyed the roots
Go back to {npc:Chavis} and say {key:hi}, {key:food}. Each time you say {key:food}, he accepts 5 roots.
1 vote for every 5 bundles of roots.
It counts what you harvested, even if you lost the physical roots. Only the ones you harvested yourself count.
Dr. Merlay's Misery: ask for the drink
Talk to {npc:Roswitha} in the Rathleton Slum: {key:hi}, {key:pint} (or {key:drink}). You receive a {item:Pint of Glooth}.
You have **10 minutes** to reach the laboratory entrance before the {item:Pint of Glooth} spoils ({item:Pint of Glooth (Green)}).
Dr. Merlay's Misery: going down to the sewers

Go **north** of Roswitha, pass {npc:Fillias} and go down to the Rathleton Ancient Sewers (use the sewer cover if needed). Walk **east** and then **north**. Pass {npc:Elliott} and go down the sewer entrance just north of him.
Dr. Merlay's Misery: reaching the laboratory

Keep going **east** to the platform next to the west wall with a {item:Ladder (Oramond)|ladder}. From there go **north** to the marked spot and go down the stairs. Head **north** to the sewer entrance and go down it.
Dr. Merlay's Misery: turn into a Rot Elemental

Use the {item:Pint of Glooth} on yourself: you turn into a {creature:Rot Elemental} for **30 seconds**. Walk **north** between the {item:Strange Metal Statue|Strange Metal Statues} and enter the laboratory.
Dr. Merlay's Misery: talking to Dr Merlay
Talk to {npc:Dr Merlay} (he has the form of a {creature:Massive Earth Elemental}): {key:hi}, {key:help}, {key:yes}. He asks you to deliver letters to some Rathleton citizens.
Dr. Merlay's Misery: deliver the letters

Leave the laboratory and return to the surface the same way you came down (sewer entrances and stairs to the Ancient Sewers and then the entrance next to {npc:Fillias}). Deliver the letters in this order:

If you want to keep the {item:Glooth Potion}, store it or drop it and say {key:lost} to {npc:Alaistar} (you can repeat this any time). The same goes for the {item:Soothe Bloom} and {npc:Azalea} ({key:lost}), once per hour.
Dr. Merlay's Misery: make the mixture
Use the {item:Glooth Potion} on the {item:Soothe Bloom} to create a {item:Cool Gloothy Mixture}.
Dr. Merlay's Misery: creating the pill

Go back to the laboratory the same way as before (the "reaching the laboratory" step) and say {key:cool gloothy mixture} to {npc:Dr Merlay}. Then use the {item:Cool Gloothy Mixture} on the {item:Particle Accelerator}, in the **southwest** corner of the laboratory. You get an {item:Ominously Glowing Pill}.
To keep the {item:Ominously Glowing Pill}, drop it or store it in the depot before reporting.
Talk to {npc:Dr Merlay} again and confirm with {key:yes}. Then leave the laboratory and return to the surface the same way you came down.
10. Tasks in the Underground Glooth Factory (Citizen rank)

Talk to {npc:Drystan Wildweed}: {key:hi}, {key:thieves}, {key:yes}. Kill **200** {creature:Glooth Bandit|Glooth Bandits} and {creature:Glooth Brigand|Glooth Brigands} (combined) and return: {key:hi}, {key:yes}. It can be done at the same time as gathering capsules.
Votes ("a certain voice in the city").

With 10 {item:Glooth Capsule|Glooth Capsules}, say {key:hi}, {key:yes} to {npc:Elbert}. He only accepts them after you finish the Glooth Bandits and Four Demanding Statues missions. To use the {item:Tainted Glooth Capsule|Tainted Glooth Capsules}, purify them with a {item:Filled Glooth Converter} (section 4): here the converter **does not break**.
Keep a {item:Filled Glooth Converter} in the depot to convert all the stained capsules.
Talk to {npc:Wesley} and ask for a {key:mission}. Then go **northeast** to the large {item:Glooth Data Machine} and use it from the **right side** to read the report.
Go back to {npc:Wesley} and say {key:hi}, {key:report}. He gives you one of the four tasks below, at random. You can do up to **3 tasks per day**.
Go **northeast** of Wesley, where the machine is. Inside the fenced area, use the **7** {item:Irrigation Funnel|Irrigation Funnels}. Then report ({key:report}).

Go **west** of Wesley until you find a {item:Water Distilling Machine} and use it to get a {item:Vial of Distilled Water}. Use the water on the **7** {item:Irrigation Funnel|Irrigation Funnels} northeast of Wesley. Then report ({key:report}).
Fill the 7 Irrigation Funnels with distilled water

Wesley gives you a {item:Hoe}. Go **southeast**, go down the hole and climb up another hole to the **south**. Use the {item:Hoe} on 5 {item:Edible Rock Fungus} to get 5 {item:Fungus Powder} (each fungus takes 1 minute to grow back). Go back the same way (through the two holes) to the farm northeast of Wesley and apply the powder to the {item:Small Gloothworm Tubes (Floss)|Small Gloothworm Tubes} **5 times**. Then report ({key:report}).
Getting 5 Fungus Powder with the Hoe on the Edible Rock Fungus
Applying 5 doses of Fungus Powder to the Small Gloothworm Tubes
In the fungus cave there are {creature:Glooth Bandit|Glooth Bandits} and {creature:Glooth Brigand|Glooth Brigands}.

Wesley gives you a {item:Rake}. Go **northeast** to the Gloothworm Farm and use the {item:Rake} on **10** {item:Small Gloothworm Tubes (Floss)|Small Gloothworm Tubes}. Then report ({key:report}) and **return the rake**.
If you lose the {item:Rake}, buy another from {npc:Maro}.
After each task Wesley tells you to read the machine again. On the third task of the day he says that is enough for now and gives you the reward.
Ask {npc:Zeronex} for the {key:harvesting} task. He gives you a {item:Milking Fork}: take **20** {item:Steel Spider Silk} from the {item:Spider (Steel)|Steel Spiders} and return to him.
Does not need access to the Underground Glooth Factory.

Ask {npc:Zeronex} for the {key:concocting} task. He gives you a {item:Bottle of Gloo} and an {item:Airtight Cloth} (you do not need shrimp). Go to the pharmacy, open the bookcases on the 2nd and 3rd floors to take {item:Glooth Farina}, {item:Pink Gloud Essence} and {item:Glooth Vinegar}, and cook in the {item:Glooth Cauldron} of the building to the east, as in section 5. Hand in the {item:Bottle of Airtight Gloo} by saying {key:concocting}.
1 vote; no known limit on repetitions.
Accepting the task resets the bookcases: you can take 3 more ingredients (1 of each) even if you have not used the previous ones. Always take them to avoid extra trips.

Ask {npc:Zeronex} for the {key:retrieving} task. He gives you a {item:Gas Bag}. In Zeronex's laboratory in the Underground Glooth Factory, calibrate the 3 machines (north, west and northwest) and fill the bag at the centre machine, as in section 5. Report with {key:retrieving}.
You can ask {npc:Georgia Rainbird} for another {item:Strange Device} with {key:lost glooth converter} and {npc:Elbert} for another {item:Glass Tube} with {key:glass tube}.
You can build several {item:Filled Glooth Converter|Filled Glooth Converters}: one for the mission and another to purify capsules.
The Milking Spiders and Cooking Gloo tasks can be done without access to the Underground Glooth Factory, but the final part of The Gloud Ship mission (Gassing Up) requires the Citizen rank.
The Underground Glooth Factory missions and tasks were added after the original quest, in the {wiki:Updates/10.7|Winter Update of 2014}.
